source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 6 if any(6 in row for row in grid) else 5
    fill = 3
    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        if len(marks) > 1:
            for c in range(marks[0], marks[-1] + 1):
                if grid[r][c] != marker:
                    out[r][c] = fill
    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        if len(marks) > 1:
            for r in range(marks[0], marks[-1] + 1):
                if grid[r][c] != marker:
                    out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
